description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Order made under Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act that published in the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1465/20  w.e.f. 21.02.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006. It contains a legal order modifying specific provisions related to stamp duty exemptions for insurance policies and financial instruments. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes, without detailing his ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The core content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
